paragraphs.text: The echoing call comes again, and this time it is answered by something closer to you. This seems a good time to get off the ground.
You select a tree with obvious footholds and a thick branch at about twice your height. You haul yourself up. You are not dressed for this.
Make a Climb roll. If you Fumble (a roll of 96 or over), go to 222. Otherwise, go to 228.
